reuse.why: Hooks into the existing guardBankAccountLink wrapper that every provider's link handler goes through and follows the assertBankAccountNotLinked pattern in link.ts.

duplication.why: One new assertion called from one place; nothing is duplicated.

placement.why: The assertion lives in accounts/link.ts next to the existing link assertion and is wired in the shared guard in app.ts.

scope.why: Only the guard, the new assertion and tests change.

maintainability.why: Small, named, single-purpose assertion invoked from the one guard all link methods share.

one_place.where: assertAccountNotClosed in server/accounts/link.ts, called once from guardBankAccountLink in server/accounts/app.ts, which wraps every *-accounts-link handler.
